quests.title: A Date with Zaffer
quests.description: Go on a date with Zaffer.

quests.title: A Drink to the Past
quests.description: Can you revive Lily Nightingale's classic cocktails?

quests.title: A Hacker's Guide to Exploring Nivalis
quests.description: Kai Galosh has a way to help you get around Nivalis without restrictions. But you'll have to act like a tourist.

quests.title: A Knight in Nivalis
quests.description: A new (old) game is sweeping Nivalis. Chess! Why? No one knows!

quests.title: Acquire Green Reeker
quests.description: Find some Green Reeker cheese for Gladstone.

quests.title: An Altar of Ones and Zeros
quests.description: Magz needs a place to pray. Help him design his apartment.

quests.title: Ashwin needs help
quests.description: Something is bothering Ashwin Chopra. Figure out why he is behaving so strangely.

quests.title: Bad Batch
quests.description: Investigate the bad batch of a drug called Post Apocalypse. Find out who was altering peoples consciousness, and why.

quests.title: Brooke's Business Opportunity
quests.description: Brooke Hazard has many ideas, and maybe his next big project is something to work on together?

quests.title: Business Empire
quests.description: Grow your business empire by acquiring licenses for venues across the city.

quests.title: Calling Cale Wyer
quests.description: Help out Cale Wyer.

quests.title: Cast Iron Alibi
quests.description: Hanz Grundown wants you to provide one of his guests with an alibi. Will you do it?

quests.title: Chained Melody
quests.description: CorpSec's anti-jazz legislation eliminated many famous bands, but one of the biggest and best was The Glitch Swings. With her bandmates in prison or exiled, the former lead singer, Andrea Cellini, must decide what she wants to do next.... and her decision will influence whether jazz has a future in Nivalis.

quests.title: Clean up!
quests.description: The restaurant is getting dirtier with each customer. Make sure to hire and assign cleaners to take care of it and keep the place clean to positively affect customer reviews.

quests.title: Comedy Showdown
quests.description: Deeala's landlord is giving her trouble. She needs your help to get him off her back.

quests.title: CorpSec Investigations
quests.description: CorpSec's Agent Teleshko is watching you. Will you obey his requests?

quests.title: CorpSec Narc
quests.description: Betray Dr Fred to CorpSec for a reward.

quests.title: Crime Scene Decorator
quests.description: Rollo has a special decorating task for you.

quests.title: Curfew
quests.description: CorpSec imposed a curfew in the Localized Unity Zone for the protection of the citizens. It is "against the law" to stay outside while the curfew is in effect. Make your way to the nearest local shelter and hide from the security cameras and drones. Maybe you can use the cloak of night to your advantage?

quests.title: Curzona Penthouse
quests.description: Mary-Nyx Curzona wants you to stage her common little Penthouse.

quests.title: Dagmar's Sabotage
quests.description: Dagmar has a plan to help you both succeed. But should you trust her?

quests.title: Deal with a Devil
quests.description: Mary-Nyx Curzona is the head of one of the most influential multi-corps in all Nivalis. Her word can decide the fate of smaller businesses like yours.

quests.title: Den of Discovery
quests.description: John Doe wants you to decorate his apartment.

quests.title: Dive Bar Deity
quests.description: Compete with your business rival Nola Berg and her fabulous cocktails.

quests.title: Dotson's Detective Agency
quests.description: Can you solve Dotson's mysteries?

quests.title: Dr Fred's Drugs
quests.description: Obtain BioX-50 for Dr Fred.

quests.title: Extend Storage
quests.description: Increase your storage so you can store more stuff.

quests.title: Find Salma's Brother
quests.description: Salma has been looking for her brother Seth for 15 years. He loved Ramen, so she eats it often in the hope she'll meet him again at one of the noodle bars one day.

quests.title: Finding the Enchiridion
quests.description: The Nivalis Enchiridion was an ancient atlas that unlocked other worlds... so the stories say. Can you find the fragments?

quests.title: Fix Rosetta
quests.description: Can you find a replacement logic relay for Holocropolis caretaker Rosetta?

quests.title: Fun in the Sun
quests.description: Find a music act for an event for Freya Portlet, the manager of Calypso Island. You have 10 days.

quests.title: Garnet. Single Dad. Seeks Love.
quests.description: Somewhere inside a loud city is a quiet voice. Can you hear it? Would you listen if you could?

quests.title: Get a Loan
quests.description: The wheels of business are greased with cash, and you need more to run your business. Get a loan or increase your funds another way.

quests.title: Gladstone's Rats
quests.description: Can you help Gladstone by deactivating all of his old rat traps?

quests.title: Good Old Gimble
quests.description: Who was Hepzibah Gimble? Someone might pay good money for information about her...

quests.title: Green Thumb
quests.description: You're going to need fresh ingredients. Rent a greenhouse near the docks and plant your first crop.

quests.title: Hide & Seek
quests.description: Better not get found.

quests.title: Historical Place of Wisdom
quests.description: Professor Kasey Remo has an interior design job for you.

quests.title: Hygiene Inspector
quests.description: Cecil Grimes is a pest. But how to avoid the hygiene inspections for good?

quests.title: I.O.U.
quests.description: You borrowed 5000 Lims from Calhoun. You must pay it back, including 20% interest... 6000 Lims in total.

quests.title: It's My Birthday!
quests.description: Throw Ziggy RaSand a party so he'll give you a Tier 3 license.

quests.title: Level Up!
quests.description: "Level Up!" is a technology that lets you live someone else's life over night. Do you have what it takes to level up?

quests.title: Lochlainn's Pain
quests.description: Lochlainn has a family in trouble. Will you help?

quests.title: Lost at Sea
quests.description: Search for the wreckage of the Annabel Lee.

quests.title: Lost Property
quests.description: A guest at the Grundown Ritz has lost a necklace overboard. Find it and return it... or not.

quests.title: Lost Time
quests.description: Another one of your landlord's tenants has lost something precious. An invaluable antique mechanic watch.

quests.title: Love Den
quests.description: Mia Jay has an interior design job for you.

quests.title: Lynnphora's Urn
quests.description: Help Lynnphora Adams find the perfect spot to scatter Eugene's ashes.

quests.title: Ma Gomba's Mushrooms
quests.description: Ma Gomba thinks mushrooms hold wisdom. Find out if she is right.

quests.title: Mala Has Questions
quests.description: Mala is very eager to run a business in Nivalis and she comes prepared. Will you answer her questions?

quests.title: Memories
quests.description: The Miso Baron has lost his memories in a botched CBI procedure. Can you help him get his memories back?

quests.title: More Fridge Space
quests.description: Your fridge space is running low. If your fridges are full, ingredients that require cooling will deteriorate very quickly.

quests.title: Movers and Shakers
quests.description: Milo needs help with his business... and his seismology.

quests.title: Nabla's Home IRL
quests.description: Nabla wants you to furnish his apartment with all the IRL stuff.

quests.title: Naming Rights
quests.description: The salty sea captain Taylor Hernz wants to commandeer the naming rights to a Nivalis landmark. Help him mark his place in history.

quests.title: Neon for Zaffer
quests.description: Obtain some neon for Zaffer.

quests.title: Neon Sellout
quests.description: Mertie needs customers and you need gossip. Convince a few people to buy a bit of neon.

quests.title: Nivalis Grind
quests.description: The greatest lie gamblers believe is they can win it all back before anyone finds out. Can you help someone who's teetering on the edge? Would you want to? What if they promised you... a cut?

quests.title: Noodle Bar Expansion
quests.description: You have set up the Noodle Bar that you inherited from Thaddeus... including its debt. Now it's time to make it a thriving business.

quests.title: Noodle Bar Introduction
quests.description: Thaddeus Carminus, the mysterious noodle bar owner wants to talk with you. This is your first step into the hospitality business.

quests.title: Oil Rig Separatists
quests.description: Delbert Cherry and the ORS is recruiting members.

quests.title: P.I.S.S.
quests.description: Can the Pantermino International Sales Symposium help you grow your business?

quests.title: Party Haven
quests.description: Ziggy wants you to design his Party Haven.

quests.title: Please Delete My Numbers
quests.description: Aengus Prince has thousands of people's DNA sequences stored. It could be dangerous.

quests.title: Poisoned Mustard
quests.description: Your mustard has turned into poison. Take care of it to keep your guests safe.

quests.title: Project Grapevine
quests.description: Clem trusted you with a package of illegal flower seeds. Are you a vigilante, or a law-abiding citizen? Make the drop or hand it in.

quests.title: Protection Racket
quests.description: Mobsters want to charge you protection money.

quests.title: Radio Waves
quests.description: Silas Rhodes works for a telecomm corp, see if he knows anything the feeds aren't saying.

quests.title: Rats ate the Bread
quests.description: Replace the bread eaten by the giant rats.

quests.title: Recruit Sal
quests.description: Recruit top-tier chef Sal Magundi.

quests.title: Retirement Party
quests.description: Find Reehan Scott, an android forced into retirement.

quests.title: Rust to Rust
quests.description: Find some industrial strength rust remover for Crabface.

quests.title: Seafaring
quests.description: Find a boat captain near the docks and take a ride out onto the waves.

quests.title: Seen a Ghost?
quests.description: Solve the mystery of the ghost in the LUZ.

quests.title: Sell Old Tech
quests.description: Rumor has it that a hacker called Nabla will pay good money for old tech...

quests.title: Silo's Playhouse
quests.description: Silo wants you to decorate his place, but isn't he a little too young for this?

quests.title: SimBot Shenanigans
quests.description: Help Roxi Fynx get a slanderous interview scrapped before it's released on the Nets.

quests.title: Slow Revolution
quests.description: Revolutions don't happen often in Nivalis, but Olive Nek is leading... something.

quests.title: Slumlord
quests.description: Pilk Dane is your friendly landlord who turns into a nightmare.

quests.title: Snapshot
quests.description: Take and deliver photography for Elaine Malloy's new book.

quests.title: Spartacus's Doom
quests.description: Can you help Spartacus live his dream?

quests.title: Stolen Apartment
quests.description: Sanderson has a special decorating task for you.

quests.title: Stranger in Need
quests.description: Can you help Palmer escape the LUZ before she's seen?

quests.title: Suck it and See
quests.description: Ceres has misplaced her husband's Persona Construct. See if you can find it.

quests.title: Surrender Old Tech
quests.description: Surrender any old tech you find to a CorpSec drop location

quests.title: Thaddeus Retirement
quests.description: Thaddeus has left you the noodle stand and retired, but where did he go?

quests.title: The Aseptic
quests.description: News of a prolific serial killer targeting the city's most impoverished citizens is circulating fast. Track down The Aseptic before The Aseptic finds you.

quests.title: The Bicameralist
quests.description: Ava thinks something might be off with the strange Bicameral Monk. Might be worth investigating.

quests.title: The Church of the Binary God
quests.description: Learn more about The Church of the Binary God and their strange, ancient religion based on ones and zeroes.

quests.title: The Club Rat Kids
quests.description: Help Kenzy Voan climb back up the reputation tower.

quests.title: The Coffee Run
quests.description: Bou Friday is down a delivery person and Nivalis needs its coffee. Can you help?

quests.title: The Critic
quests.description: Marcelle Denuite is Nivalis' top food critic. Can he help your business?

quests.title: The Last of the Roid Droids
quests.description: Meet Floyd, the last remaining "Roid Droid". These androids were built for only one purpose: to do the work that humans couldn't.

quests.title: The Lost Art of Anthony G
quests.description: Help Finn Amano with the lost art of Anthony G.

quests.title: The Lost Leg
quests.description: Help Marius find his leg.

quests.title: The Man Who Murdered Death
quests.description: Alan Fontus has some strange ideas about mortality. Learn more.

quests.title: The Measurer
quests.description: Rosco Foreman is mapping the streets for Curzona. He has knowledge to share, and maybe you can help him.

quests.title: The Network
quests.description: Ah, the restaurant biz in Nivalis... welcome to the grind. It might be worth it to make a few friends and learn the lay of the land. Just be careful who you get wrapped up with.

quests.title: The Pierreponts
quests.description: Cassius Pierrepont IV needs help with some family issues.

quests.title: The Scorpion
quests.description: There's something odd about this shimmer chip you were given.

quests.title: The Shipping Forecast
quests.description: Who's reading the shipping forecast in this day and age? And why?

quests.title: The Songs of Fauxter Glambeat
quests.description: Fauxter Glambeat is putting the band back together.

quests.title: Therapy Sessions
quests.description: Alfie Gunfibel is offering "therapy" sessions. Are they worth your time?

quests.title: Thirst Trap
quests.description: Mia Jay, a happy-go-lucky collector of k20 Tumblers needs help finding the last seven styles missing from her collection.

quests.title: Tongue Twister
quests.description: Follow Sal's advice and buy a little something extra to give your food a boost.

quests.title: Trade Talks
quests.description: Botan Noss has difficulties getting the parts he needs for his repairs. Can you help to re-establish his supply chain?

quests.title: Trouble in Announcer Land
quests.description: Help find out what's troubling e-sports announcer Kai Reston.

quests.title: Truth Be Told
quests.description: Find the truth behind what happened to John Doe (possibly even his real name too).

quests.title: Underground Fish Market
quests.description: There's some shady dealings going on at the Docks. Prove you're worth joining the club.

quests.title: Vanishing Act
quests.description: It seems Zee might have found her place beyond the Grid.

quests.title: What Did Eldridge Do?
quests.description: Eldridge is in exile. Help him remember why and maybe even recover his reputation.

quests.title: When the Chips are down
quests.description: Harper is down on her luck. Help her get back on her feet.

quests.title: Where is Ava?
quests.description: Help Ava find out what happened to her human body.
